Spencer Davis Group - I'm a Man (1966)

This was the final Spencer Davis Group release to feature Steve Winwood, who left to form Traffic. It was originally written for a documentary called Swinging London, but the band liked it so much they saved it for a single. This was written in 1955, Bo Diddley's R&B classic number of the same name, which was later an American Top 20 hit for The Yardbirds, as well as Chicago's 7 minutes, 40 seconds version recorded for their 1969 debut album "The Chicago Transit Authority".

Bo Diddley's original "I'm a Man" is ranked number 369 on Rolling Stone magazine's list of "The 500 Greatest Songs of All Time". In 2012, the song along with the self-named A-side song "Bo Diddley" was added to the Library of Congress's National Recording Registry list of "culturally, historically, or aesthetically important" American sound recordings.
